paras: Anolis garridoi, also known commonly as the Escambray twig anole, is a species of lizard in the family Dactyloidae. The species is endemic to Cuba.
The specific name, garridoi, is in honor of Cuban herpetologist Orlando H. Garrido.
A. garridoi is found in Sancti Spíritus Province, Cuba.
The preferred natural habitat of A. garridoi is savanna, at altitudes of 700–800 m (2,300–2,600 ft).
A. garridoi belongs to the Anolis angusticeps species group.
